title: Agent Bricks CLI is in Beta
body:
The Agent Bricks CLI (`databricks-agentbricks`) is a command-line tool for building and deploying custom code agents on Databricks. Scaffold a project from a bundled framework template, run it locally, and deploy it to the Databricks agent runtime, with managed memory, sessions, tools, and MLflow tracing wired up from one authenticated command.

See [Agent Bricks CLI](/aws/en/agents/custom-agents/agent-bricks-cli).
